prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color material texture for a realistic lunar habitat 3D simulation.
Input image 1: photographic authenticity reference only. Generate a NEW flat material scan, not the pictured habitat or any image layout.
Primary request: Neutral medium-gray lunar regolith, a physically authentic photographic sample scan. Very fine dry powder and densely packed small angular mineral particles. Subtle varied gray mineral grains only, mostly submillimeter dust-scale detail. No macro rocks, no boulders, no craters, no footprints, no scenery and no strong light direction. Real loose geological dust, not concrete, not sand dunes. Absolutely no recognizable terrain formations.
Style/medium: extraordinarily realistic high-resolution photographic macro material scan, tiny tangible physical detail, absolutely not stylized and not a CGI render.
Composition/framing: square 2048 x 2048. Orthographic straight-on / top-down flat scan, one continuous material filling every pixel. All detail stays in sharp focus. Seamless texture with matching opposite edges, no frame and no border.
Lighting: de-lit base color / albedo scan under perfectly uniform diffuse cross-polarized illumination. No large-scale directional illumination, no broad specular reflections, no long cast shadows, no vignette or brightness gradients. The 3D renderer will provide scene lighting.
Constraints: a SINGLE seamless material surface with fine scale details only. No hardware, text, symbols, logos, panels, screws or other large repeated motifs. No sphere or plane preview. No scene or perspective. No objects or background.
Output: one independent full-bleed square opaque texture image.
qa: Inspected original image. Uniform continuous material scan with no scenery, hardware, text or frame. Generated tile edges may need blending for mathematically exact tiling.
